name: Art Nouveau (web)
summary: Whiplash curves, plant forms and hand-drawn lettering inside framed panels. It came from Paris, Brussels, Vienna and Glasgow around 1900. On screen it suits heritage, craft and botanical brands.

philosophy.core_thesis: Ornament is not decoration added to a thing: the line of the plant grows into the structure of the page.
design_principles: Draw every panel frame with a curved border: corner radius 24px to 48px, or an arched top at 50% of the width.
Run one continuous organic line (stroke 2px to 3px) along the edge of each section, and let it end in a leaf, a bud or a whiplash curl.
Use a muted natural palette of 5 colours: moss, sage, ochre, rose and cream. Keep saturation below 45%.
Set headlines in a display face with a flowing, calligraphic shape at 40px or larger; set body in a readable old-style serif at 17px to 18px.
Fill the page background with a pattern tile of 120px to 240px made from stems and petals at 8% opacity.
Place the hero as a tall panel with a 3:4 ratio, framed by a border of 6px to 12px with a floral corner.
Make buttons pill-shaped (radius 999px) with a 2px outline and a filled leaf-green hover state.
anti_patterns: Straight rectangular containers with sharp corners
Neon, primary or high-saturation colours above 45%
Symmetric rigid grids of equal cards
Photographic stock images without a frame or a tint
Flat decoration with no link to a plant or hand-drawn line
Drop shadows that make a panel float

layout.grid_mechanics: A single column of 720px to 960px with side margins of 8% to 12%; ornamental borders occupy the margins. Panels follow a 4px baseline and break the grid with arches and curves.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 12, 24, 36, 60 and 96px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero with asymmetric ornament; body text flush left; the ornament line leads the eye from the top-left to the bottom-right.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 24px to 48px radius, arched tops and framed borders of 6px to 12px; images sit in arch, oval or keyhole masks.

font_pairings.note: Classical capitals with flourish for display; a warm old-style serif for text.
A high-contrast display face with a clear text face.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0.02em; body stays at 0; small caps labels take +0.08em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights only for body: regular (400) and bold (700); display runs at 700.
Set the first letter of an article as a drop cap of 3 lines.
Set labels in small caps at 13px with +0.08em tracking.

color.palette_structure: Muted botanical hues on a cream ground; one gold accent for borders.
color.contrast_rules: Body text holds at least 7:1 on cream; ochre and rose carry ornament and large type only.
color.surface_treatment: Flat tint with a printed paper grain at 4% opacity; no gradient except a 2-stop wash in a panel header.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft, single light from the top left; shadows are 0px; depth comes from layered borders.

materiality.surface_simulation: Printed paper with gilt lines; the surface imitates a lithographic poster, not glass or metal.
materiality.border_rules: Double border: an outer 2px moss line and an inner 1px ochre line, 6px apart.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. At most one 1px offset line in ochre behind a panel.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons with a 1.5px to 2px stroke, round caps and round joins, drawn as leaves, stems and buds.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Hand-drawn botanical and female figures in flat colour with a black outline of 2px; use as border art and as a hero plate.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: slow organic moves; a border line draws itself along its path at 600ms to 900ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover fills the pill in leaf green and draws the border line again in 400ms; active state darkens by 8%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels craft, nature and an unhurried, romantic care.

avoid_when: The product is a dense data tool.
The brand must feel technical, minimal or masculine.
The page needs strict, scannable tables.

modifiers.how: Drop the borders and curves; keep the serif body and set the page on a 12-column grid.
Replace the curves with arcs and straight lines and add a gold on black palette.
Keep the leaf palette as flat fills; remove the borders and patterns.

pack.why: A thin, even, round-ended line that follows the flowing stroke of a plant drawing.

ground.why: Art Nouveau posters and book pages hold the picture in a thin drawn frame on warm paper.
